name: Multivariate simulation framework
model_likelihood: Genotype effects f(v) on K traits with multivariate normal residuals N(0,c).
inference_algorithm: Generate data by structured, uniform, effect-reflecting or real-data-informed choices of v and c; no parameter-fitting algorithm is proposed.
estimand: Simulated individual-level genotype and correlated phenotype data.
data_input: Specified genetic-effect vector v and residual covariance/correlation parameters c, optionally informed by real data.
tunable_settings: Number of phenotypes; genetic-effect vector v; covariance parameters c; allele frequency; simulation scenario; disease prevalence for binary outcomes
